newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on buying of blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on buying of blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Sunday on heavy buying of blue chips on hopes that an election victory of industrialist Nawaz Sharif would push stock prices up, dealers said.
"There is both genuine and speculative buying of all the heavily-traded blue chips," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "Sharif's victory chances in elections are bright."
The Karachi index rose 25.27 points, or 1.74 percent, to end at 1,476.64 amid 175 gainers and 67 losers. PTCL rose 0.55 rupees to 30.35. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
